text: For the postmortem: what time did I first report the kiosks offline on 3 Aug, and what was the guard doing in the meantime?
reply_text:
Gideon, you first reported the kiosks offline at 10:42 AM on 3 Aug in this channel. You said both inbound lanes showed a white screen after badge scan.

While they were down, the guard wrote trailer numbers on a clipboard. Kiosk 1 came back at 11:03. At that point the guard checked in trailer 8836 and dispatch could see it. You posted at 11:08 that both lanes were working as of 11:07.

The channel doesn't say whether the guard went back to normal check-in on both lanes at exactly that time. It also doesn't say what the guard did between 11:03 and 11:07.
